nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite partially ordered set. Every antichain $A$ in $\alpha$ has at most as many elements as the maximum antichain size of $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Antichains are no larger than the maximum antichain size

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite partially ordered set. The maximum antichain size of $\alpha$ equals its minimum chain cover size: the largest number of elements of an antichain in $\alpha$ equals the smallest number of chains whose union is $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Dilworth's theorem

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite partially ordered set. Some antichain in $\alpha$ has exactly as many elements as the maximum antichain size of $\alpha$.
nodes.title: The maximum antichain size is attained

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite partially ordered set. Some chain cover $C$ of $\alpha$, a finite set of chains of $\alpha$ whose union is $\alpha$, consists of exactly as many chains as the minimum chain cover size of $\alpha$.
nodes.title: The minimum chain cover size is attained

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a partially ordered set. A finite set $C$ of finite subsets of $\alpha$ is a chain cover of $\alpha$ when every member of $C$ is a chain and every element of $\alpha$ lies in some member of $C$.
nodes.title: Chain cover

nodes.summary: For a finite partially ordered set $\alpha$, the maximum antichain size of $\alpha$ (its width) is the largest number of elements of an antichain in $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Maximum antichain size

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite partially ordered set. If $C$ is a chain cover of $\alpha$, that is, a finite set of chains of $\alpha$ whose union is $\alpha$, then the minimum chain cover size of $\alpha$ is at most the number of chains in $C$.
nodes.title: Chain covers bound the minimum chain cover size

nodes.summary: For a finite partially ordered set $\alpha$, the minimum chain cover size of $\alpha$ is the smallest number of chains in a chain cover of $\alpha$, that is, in a finite set of chains of $\alpha$ whose union is $\alpha$.
nodes.title: Minimum chain cover size

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
